UI_MSM_Help_Safety_02:
Yes. The mod ships open .ps1 and .cmd scripts,
both plain text, both readable in Notepad.
UI_MSM_Help_Safety_03:
Nothing in the mod has network access.
Nothing modifies the PZ executable.
Uninstall returns your saves to vanilla state.
UI_MSM_Help_Safety_05:
On a 500ms loop it does four things:
1. Reads small .txt signal files from Zomboid/Lua/.
2. Copies, moves, or deletes folders in Zomboid/
   using robocopy.
3. Runs PowerShell to capture the game window.
4. Writes a Done file back so the game sees the result.
UI_MSM_Help_Safety_06:
No registry edits.
No external network calls.
No background services or autostart.
UI_MSM_Help_Safety_08:
Open ManualSave_Watcher.ps1 in Notepad.
Task Manager > Details: Watcher = powershell.exe
UI_MSM_Help_Safety_09: with ManualSave_Watcher.ps1 in the command line.
UI_MSM_Help_Safety_10: Resource Monitor > Network: no sockets opened.
UI_MSM_Help_Safety_12:
Some AVs flag any unsigned .ps1 that calls
robocopy - a heuristic, not a real
detection of malicious behaviour.
UI_MSM_Help_Safety_13:
Read the file first, then decide.
If you don't trust it: don't run it.
Lua side stays disabled; PZ behaves as vanilla.
UI_MSM_Help_Safety_14:
Both files are byte-identical across all Steam
Workshop installs of the same mod version.
UI_MSM_Help_Watcher_02:
PZ runs Lua through Kahlua, a stripped interpreter.
Kahlua hides almost the entire os.* library:
UI_MSM_Help_Watcher_03: no os.execute, os.rename, os.remove, no mkdir.
UI_MSM_Help_Watcher_04:
A manual save is a folder copy. Lua inside PZ
cannot do that. The Watcher is the smallest
possible workaround: an external Windows process.
UI_MSM_Help_Watcher_06:
SAVE           Copy active world to a named slot.
LOAD           Copy a slot back to the active world.
DELETE         Recursively remove a slot folder.
RENAME         Rename a slot folder.
CLONE          Copy a slot to a new name.
CLONE_MODS     Clone a slot with a custom mod list.
RENAME_WORLD   Rename the world folder itself.
SCAN_VANILLA   List existing vanilla saves.
IMPORT         Copy vanilla saves into ManualSave.

The Watcher polls %USERPROFILE%\\Zomboid\\Lua\\
for ManualSave_Signal.txt written by the Lua side.
Parses the op > runs it > writes Done.txt back.

A heartbeat counter increments every tick so the
game can detect if the Watcher process dies.
UI_MSM_Help_Watcher_10:
No install, no service, no autostart.
If you don't start the .cmd the mod is inert.
This keeps the install trivially reversible.

UI_MSM_Help_Quicksave_02:
An instant copy of the active save folder taken
without leaving the game. The world keeps running
while the copy happens in the background.
UI_MSM_Help_Quicksave_03:
Use Quick Save sparingly. Full Save is the right
choice in most situations - see Save > Full Save.
UI_MSM_Help_Quicksave_04: WHAT HAPPENS WHEN YOU CLICK QUICK SAVE
UI_MSM_Help_Quicksave_05: 1. A screenshot of your game is taken automatically.
UI_MSM_Help_Quicksave_06: Used as the save thumbnail. Works in any display mode.
UI_MSM_Help_Quicksave_07: 2. The mod waits for the screenshot to finish.

UI_MSM_Help_Quicksave_09:

4. The Watcher copies your save folder to a backup slot.
UI_MSM_Help_Quicksave_10:

   A thumbnail and the save size are stored alongside it.
UI_MSM_Help_Quicksave_11:
5. Done - the UI confirms the save completed.
   The game keeps running throughout.
UI_MSM_Help_Quicksave_13:
Quick Save copies what is on disk. PZ flushes
lazily - the copied state is 'recent past',
not 'this exact frame'.

UI_MSM_Help_Fullsave_02:
A save that exits to the main menu, lets PZ flush
all in-memory state to disk, then copies the
consistent folder to a backup slot.
UI_MSM_Help_Fullsave_03:
The only save type guaranteed to capture
the full world state.
UI_MSM_Help_Fullsave_06:
Saves, returns to the main menu, stays there.
Use when you actually want to stop playing.
UI_MSM_Help_Fullsave_07:
1. A screenshot is taken before the game closes.
2. The game exits to the main menu.
   This lets PZ write all data to disk completely.
3. The Watcher copies the save folder to a backup slot.
4. The main menu appears. The save is done.
UI_MSM_Help_Fullsave_09:
Saves, returns to menu briefly, then immediately
reloads the world. Reliable as Full Save.
UI_MSM_Help_Fullsave_10:
1. A screenshot is taken before the game closes.
2. The game exits to the main menu.
3. The Watcher copies the save folder to a backup slot.
4. The game automatically reloads the slot you just saved.
   No button press needed.
UI_MSM_Help_Fullsave_12: Save & Return calls quit() then re-enters the world.
UI_MSM_Help_Fullsave_13:
In exclusive fullscreen the GPU display mode swaps

UI_MSM_Help_Fullsave_14:

Default to Full Save - it is the only trustworthy
backup. Cost: time to exit and re-enter the world.
UI_MSM_Help_Fullsave_19:
End of session, the before-bed save.
Before any mod change.
Before Edit Mods or Rename World operations.
Any time there is no specific reason for Quick Save.

UI_MSM_Help_Rename_02:
Renames the slot folder on disk.
The new name is what the Load screen displays.
UI_MSM_Help_Rename_05:
Spaces become underscores.
Characters invalid in Windows paths are replaced
with _  (< > : \" / \\ | ? *)
Unicode allowed; avoid emoji for compatibility.
UI_MSM_Help_Rename_09:
Rename changes only the slot folder.
The world folder and its name in PZ stay the same.
UI_MSM_Help_Rename_10: To rename the world: World ops > Rename World.
UI_MSM_Help_Delete_02: Permanently removes the slot folder and thumbnail.
UI_MSM_Help_Delete_03:
There is no recycle bin.
Once confirmed, the data is gone.
UI_MSM_Help_Delete_05:
A dialog asks before deleting.
You must explicitly confirm to proceed.
UI_MSM_Help_Delete_07:
Only the selected slot is removed.
Other slots in the same world stay intact.
Vanilla saves in Zomboid/Saves/ are never touched.
UI_MSM_Help_Import_02:
Brings existing vanilla saves (Zomboid/Saves/) into
the ManualSave system so they appear alongside
manual saves and can be renamed, duplicated, etc.
UI_MSM_Help_Import_03:
The originals are not moved or deleted.
Import is a copy.
UI_MSM_Help_Import_05:
Main menu only.
Import is disabled in-game because scanning
Zomboid/Saves/ requires no world to be locked.
UI_MSM_Help_Import_07:
1. Click Import. Watcher scans Zomboid/Saves/.
2. Import screen shows every vanilla save found in
   a flat list. Already-imported saves are marked.
3. Use filters (All / Unimported / Imported) and sort
   to find what you need. Select All for bulk work.
4. Tick the saves you want and click Import.
5. Watcher copies each one. Entries appear in list.
UI_MSM_Help_Import_09:
Each imported world becomes one slot whose name
matches the world name.
Mod list is parsed from the world's mods.txt.
UI_MSM_Help_Import_10: Map list and thumbnail fill lazily on first load.
UI_MSM_Help_Renameworld_02:
Renames the world folder under
ManualSaves/<gmode>/<world>/.
Every slot inside that world is now grouped under
the new world name.
UI_MSM_Help_Renameworld_03: Different from Rename, which changes only one slot.
UI_MSM_Help_Renameworld_05:
You imported a world named something generic
(Sandbox_2026-04-22) and want a meaningful name.
You spawned with a typo in the world name and want
to fix it once, not per slot.
UI_MSM_Help_Renameworld_07:
Cannot rename while that world is loaded.
The folder must be free of locks.
Go to main menu before renaming.
UI_MSM_Help_Renameworld_08:
All slots reload metadata after the rename.
Thumbnails persist.
UI_MSM_Help_Stripmods_02:
Empties the mods.txt of a slot so the next load
does not require any of the original mods.
UI_MSM_Help_Stripmods_04:
A mod the world needs was broken by a PZ patch.
A mod was removed from Workshop and is gone.
Recovering character state without the full mod list.
UI_MSM_Help_Stripmods_06:
Not a clean migration.
Mods that added custom items, recipes, traits, or
vehicles will appear broken on load.
The save loads; mod-added content may not behave.
UI_MSM_Help_Stripmods_08:
1. Select the slot.
2. Duplicate it - original is untouched.
3. Strip Mods on the duplicate.
4. Load the clone to inspect.

One-shot modifiers attached to a specific slot.
Take effect once on the next Load with Flags,
then cleared.
UI_MSM_Help_Recovery_03:
Reset zombies cannot be undone after loading.
For other flags, reloading an earlier backup is enough.
Duplicate the slot before using Reset zombies.
UI_MSM_Help_Recovery_06:
Strips zombie data from chunk files before load.
They respawn fresh according to world settings.
UI_MSM_Help_Recovery_07: Useful if zombies are corrupted or blocking spawn.
UI_MSM_Help_Recovery_08: Cannot be undone after loading. Duplicate the slot first.
UI_MSM_Help_Recovery_13: Restores health to full, clears injuries and infections.
UI_MSM_Help_Recovery_14: Does not clear hunger, thirst, or other moodles.
UI_MSM_Help_Recovery_16:

then the natural cycle resumes.
Should work even with weather mods active.
UI_MSM_Help_Recovery_18:

Dawn 06:00 / Midday 12:00 / Dusk 18:00 / Midnight 00:00.
UI_MSM_Help_Recovery_19: Day count and calendar are not affected.

UI_MSM_Help_Trouble_02: The Watcher is not running or has crashed.
UI_MSM_Help_Trouble_03:
Double-click ManualSave_Watcher.cmd.
Wait 2 seconds. The bar should disappear.
If it stays red: see Watcher won't start below.
UI_MSM_Help_Trouble_05: Most common cause: stale .lock file from a crash.
UI_MSM_Help_Trouble_06:
Open %USERPROFILE%\\Zomboid\\Lua\\
Delete ManualSave_Watcher.lock.
Double-click the .cmd again.
UI_MSM_Help_Trouble_07:
Other causes:
PowerShell execution policy blocked the script.
Antivirus quarantined the .cmd or .ps1 file.
Windows in S Mode (cannot run unsigned scripts).
UI_MSM_Help_Trouble_10: Switch to Borderless Windowed: Options > Display.
UI_MSM_Help_Trouble_14: Keep it visible; compositor needs an active surface.
UI_MSM_Help_Trouble_15: A SAVE IS MISSING FROM THE LIST
UI_MSM_Help_Trouble_16:
Is the Watcher running?
Check Zomboid\\Lua\\ManualSave_Index.txt.
UI_MSM_Help_Trouble_17:
Slot in Index but not in UI: close/reopen Load screen.
Slot not in Index: folder moved outside mod. Use Import.
UI_MSM_Help_Trouble_19:
Exclusive fullscreen + display mode swap on reload.
Fix: Options > Display > Borderless Windowed.
UI_MSM_Help_Trouble_21:
robocopy on a large save can take several seconds.
Wait 10 seconds before assuming a freeze.
If truly frozen: Task Manager > kill the Watcher
cmd.exe, then resume PZ and restart the Watcher.
UI_MSM_Help_Limits_02:
cmd.exe, robocopy, PowerShell, and user32.dll
have no working substitutes on other platforms
without rewriting the Watcher entirely.
UI_MSM_Help_Limits_04:
PZ flushes to disk lazily, so:
Zombie positions are typically stale or partial.
Distant chunks may be in an outdated state.
Weather and time of day may not match on-screen.
UI_MSM_Help_Limits_05: For fully consistent state: use Full Save.
UI_MSM_Help_Limits_06: THE WATCHER IS A SEPARATE PROCESS
UI_MSM_Help_Limits_07: Forgetting to start the .cmd disables all operations.
UI_MSM_Help_Limits_08:
The Lua side will not auto-launch the Watcher -
that would break the trivially-uninstall guarantee.
UI_MSM_Help_Limits_10: Slot names go through Windows path rules.
UI_MSM_Help_Limits_11:
Emoji, RTL chars, and some CJK sequences may be
sanitized to _.
UI_MSM_Help_Limits_18:
Each backup is a full folder copy.
Late-game worlds: 200-500 MB per slot.
UI_MSM_Help_Locations_06: Each slot folder: world snapshot + thumb.png.
UI_MSM_Help_Locations_09: Untouched by ManualSave except Import (read only).
UI_MSM_Help_Locations_12:
Signal.txt      Lua > Watcher: command to run.
Done.txt        Watcher > Lua: result.
Heartbeat.txt   Watcher liveness counter.
Watcher.lock    Single-instance lock.
Index.txt       Cached list of all slots.
VanillaScan.txt  Vanilla save list for Import.
ImportQueue.txt  Worlds queued for import.
Pending.txt     Save & Return re-entry info.
Meta_*.txt      Per-slot metadata.
Flags_*.txt     Per-slot recovery flags.
UI_MSM_Help_Locations_15:
Managed by Watcher. Cannot be relocated: PZ's
texture API only reads from inside Zomboid/Saves/.
UI_MSM_Help_Glossary_02:
Named manual backup. Folder at
ManualSaves/<gmode>/<world>/<slot>/.
Multiple slots can belong to the same world.
UI_MSM_Help_Glossary_04:
A PZ world folder (Sandbox/Riverside, etc.).
Contains chunks, zombie data, weather, seed.
UI_MSM_Help_Glossary_06:
PZ game mode group: Sandbox, Apocalypse,
Survivor, Builder, Custom.
UI_MSM_Help_Glossary_08:
The external Windows process (Watcher.cmd/.ps1) that
performs file operations Lua cannot.
UI_MSM_Help_Glossary_10:
Small .txt files in Zomboid/Lua/ used to pass
commands and results between Lua and Watcher.
UI_MSM_Help_Glossary_12:
A counter the Watcher increments every tick.
If it stops changing, the game knows Watcher died.
UI_MSM_Help_Glossary_14:
Instant in-game backup. Fast but state held only
in memory (zombies, weather) may not match.
UI_MSM_Help_Glossary_16:
Backup that exits to main menu so PZ flushes
everything before the copy. Slower, fully consistent.
UI_MSM_Help_Glossary_18:
Full Save that auto-reloads the slot it just saved.
Works best in Borderless Windowed display mode.
UI_MSM_Help_Glossary_20:
Creates a clone of a slot with a custom mod list.
Checked mods are included; unchecked are excluded.
Mod-added content from removed mods may break.
UI_MSM_Help_Glossary_22:
One-shot modifier for a slot. Applied once on
Load with Flags, then cleared automatically.
UI_MSM_Help_Glossary_24:
Flat list of all slots, rebuilt by the Watcher
whenever slots change. Drives the Load screen.
UI_MSM_Help_Glossary_26:
PNG screenshot (thumb.png) inside each slot.
Captured via PrintWindow(PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT).

Edit Mods shows every installed mod alongside the ones recorded in the save.
Mods in the save start checked. Checked = included in the clone.
Uncheck a mod to drop it; check an unchecked mod to add it.
UI_MSM_Help_EditMods_03: The original slot is always kept. Edit Mods only creates clones.
UI_MSM_Help_EditMods_06: Mod is in the save and installed. Starts checked. Safe to keep or uncheck.
UI_MSM_Help_EditMods_08:
Mod is installed but not in this save. Starts unchecked.
Check it to add it to the clone's mod list.
UI_MSM_Help_EditMods_10:
Mod is listed in the save but not installed on this PC. Starts checked.
Use Exclude missing to uncheck all amber mods at once.
UI_MSM_Help_EditMods_12:
Exclude missing  - unchecks all amber mods at once.
Reset            - restores all checkboxes to the original save state.
UI_MSM_Help_EditMods_14: Uncheck mods to remove them from the clone, or check unchecked mods to add them.
UI_MSM_Help_EditMods_15: Use Sort and the category dropdown to browse. Search filters by name.
UI_MSM_Help_EditMods_16: Give the clone a name at the bottom and click Create copy.
UI_MSM_Help_EditMods_18:
The clone lists only the checked mods in its mods.txt.
Mod content already in the world (items, structures) is not changed.
UI_MSM_Help_EditMods_19: The original slot stays untouched. Load it to return to the full mod state.
UI_MSM_Help_EditMods_20: Items, recipes, vehicles, or traits from removed mods will appear broken on first load of the clone.
